notes.title: Middle Evil: The Priest Update 1.01
notes.content:
It's been a week since the game was released.
I analyzed the reviews and comments on the store page and made a small update to the game:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to navigate in the main menu and pause menu using the mouse.
[*] Due to numerous requests, improved the readability of letters in the book - now they have a white background.
[*] Made some optimizations, as the game was running slower than it should on high-resolution monitors.
[*] Added the ability to switch to windowed mode with the "F" key in the main menu.
[*] Adjusted the ghost's hitbox; now it is positioned lower than before.
[*] Adjusted the depth of mushrooms relative to the character.
[*] Fixed some words in the control localization.
[/list]
